manifest.matching: exact content_sha256; explicit str.strip only when full model inputs are identical

tokenizer.fields: all tokenizer fields and same-batch padded fields must match

dense.gold_policy: reviewed primary qrels only; support is not scored
dense.metric_interpretation: Binary relevance over a flat primary-gold set: Hit means at least one gold unit; Recall measures gold-unit coverage. Equivalent alternatives and jointly necessary evidence are not grouped, so these metrics do not measure answer completeness.
